name: scad-ai-ide
description: OpenSCAD modeling, preview, libraries, CAD verification and AI agent tools for VS Code

scad-ai-ide.openscadPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the OpenSCAD executable, or a macOS `.app`. Leave empty for automatic discovery (PATH, then common installation locations). Runs on the extension host, including SSH, WSL, or containers.

scad-ai-ide.runtimeCommand.markdownDescription: Selected runtime launch command, including Flatpak/Snap arguments. Use **SCAD AI IDE: Select OpenSCAD Runtime** to change it. `openscadPath` takes precedence when nonempty.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.path.description: Absolute path to openscad-lsp on the extension host. Empty uses the bundled binary, then openscad-lsp on PATH.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.searchPaths.description: Absolute OpenSCAD library directories. Changing this setting restarts the server to remove stale paths.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.defaultParame.description: Include optional default parameters in LSP completion snippets.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.indent.description: Whitespace used by the OpenSCAD formatter.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.queryFile.description: Absolute path to a custom Topiary formatting query. Empty uses the server default.

scad-ai-ide.preview.format.description: The format to use for the 3D preview. 3MF supports colors but requires OpenSCAD Nightly. STL is universally supported.

enumDescriptions: Image-based Boolean preview using the independent Preview Exporter and Goldfeather depth/stencil rendering (macOS ARM64).
Standard interactive mesh preview using the selected OpenSCAD CLI.
scad-ai-ide.preview.renderMode.description: Fast image-based preview or Full Render. Both support camera navigation.

scad-ai-ide.preview.slicerExecutable.description: Optional path to the slicer executable (e.g., Bambu Studio or PrusaSlicer). If left empty, the OS default application for the 3D model will be used.

scad-ai-ide.preview.enableLazyUnion.description: Enable lazy unions, creating a multi-part exported object.

scad-ai-ide.markdown.preview.enabled.description: Show Preview and Source tabs for OpenSCAD fenced blocks in built-in and extension-managed Markdown previews. Requires workspace trust and an available OpenSCAD runtime.

enumDescriptions: Image-based Boolean preview using the independent Preview Exporter and Goldfeather depth/stencil rendering (macOS ARM64).

scad-ai-ide.markdown.preview.renderMode.description: Fast image-based preview or Full Render. Both support camera navigation.

scad-ai-ide.preview.exporterPath.description: Independent bin/openscad-preview-exporter wrapper (macOS ARM64, openscad-2026.11-RC0, Schema v1). Empty discovers the managed installation and PATH. Full Render uses the separately selected OpenSCAD CLI.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_capabilities_discover
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Discover live availability, constraints and tool names for Runtime, Libraries, Customizer and diagnostics. No changes; returns bounded capability metadata.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_operation_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Poll a specific operation ID or list recent operations. Returns running/terminal state and progress message, no changes.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_operation_cancel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cancel one Agent operation by exact id, OR request cancellation of the current Runtime installation / Library task by domain=runtime|libraries, including tasks started in the GUI. Choose exactly one. Returns cancellationRequested, not proof the task stopped: re-read domain state or operation status; critical transactions may finish.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_state
languageModelTools.displayName: Read OpenSCAD Runtime: current CLI and installed versions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the SAME local runtime inventory as Runtime Panel, without opening it. state.activeRuntime is the currently selected CLI with full version, command.executable, argsPrefix, source and release metadata, or null if none is selected; it is independent of pagination. state.runtimes.items lists detected installed CLI versions/paths/sources; follow hasMore/nextOffset to enumerate all. discovery reports ready/restricted/error and configured-path failures. This inventory is on the workspace extension host, not necessarily the client machine, and is not an exhaustive filesystem scan. Use runtime_refresh when stale; discovery/probing requires Workspace Trust. runtime_builds lists downloadable releases, NOT installed versions.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_builds
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read all downloadable OpenSCAD CLI releases for the extension host, including exact build IDs, versions, channels and installed flags. Set refresh=true to force the SAME online refresh as the GUI Available Refresh button, even when cached. Follow builds.hasMore/nextOffset; optional channel filter. Catalog errors fail explicitly; installed versions/current CLI are available from runtime_state. Network read only. recommendedBuild returns the full recommended release independently of filtering/pagination, matching the GUI recommendation card.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_refresh
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Rescan locally installed CLI runtimes (default mode=rescan), or coalesce a silent Installed-tab refresh with mode=installed. Requires Workspace Trust because discovery probes executables. Does not refresh the ONLINE catalog: use runtime_builds with refresh=true for the GUI Available Refresh action. Returns selected CLI, installed inventory and discovery status.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_installBuild
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install an exact numeric build ID returned by runtime_builds. Downloads to managed storage; supports cancellation and returns verified discovery state. Requires trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_installArchive
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install a host-local archive at an absolute path. Validates archive safety and probes runtime; managed storage only, trust required. Supports cancellation.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_addExecutable
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Probe and select a host-local executable or macOS app at an absolute path. Changes global runtime selection after validation; trust required.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_select
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Select the exact runtime ID from runtime_state. Changes global runtime configuration; returns actual active runtime and updates Preview. Trust and current identity required.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_remove
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove an exact managed runtime ID from runtime_state. Independent user confirmation required; unmanaged paths rejected. Revalidates managed identity and returns discovered state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_state
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read active model target URI, revision, complete parameter types/ranges/default/current values and preset status. Overrides do not edit SCAD source; no panel required.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set validated parameter overrides atomically on the exact target/revision from customizer_state. Values must match parameter schema. Updates GUI/Preview; does not edit SCAD source.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_reset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reset one named parameter or all overrides for exact target/revision. Returns actual values; updates Preview without editing source.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_applyPreset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: applyPreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Empty name applies design defaults. Overrides do not edit source. Each selection starts from design defaults plus this set, clearing prior set Overrides. Unverified file versions are read-only.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_createPreset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: createPreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Current-value snapshots must replay without value or type loss; otherwise PRESET_INVALID_VALUE preserves files and state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_savePreset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: savePreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Current-value snapshots must replay without value or type loss; otherwise PRESET_INVALID_VALUE preserves files and state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_deletePreset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: deletePreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Requires independent user confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_importPresets
languageModelTools.modelDescription: importPresets for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Import does not apply a set. Unknown versions are preserved for read-only analysis; apply and writes require verified compatibility.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_exportPresets
languageModelTools.modelDescription: exportPresets for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Current-value snapshots must replay without value or type loss; otherwise PRESET_INVALID_VALUE preserves files and state. Exporting existing sets does not validate the current snapshot.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search real registry metadata for IDs, exact versions and supported layouts. Bounded query, pagination and optional detail ID. Returns freshness/errors; no install. Includes the same layout/installability errors, version labels and cached flags shown in GUI registry rows.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_refresh
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Refresh registry independent of panels. Network read, returns actual catalog status/errors; cached data is identified.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_projectState
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List workspace projects, or dependencies for one exact project path returned by this tool. Reports manifest/lock and mount state; no writes. Includes shared busy/cancellable/message/error activity for tasks started in GUI or Agent; use operation_cancel with domain=libraries to request cancellation, then read state until busy clears.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_globalState
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect bounded global cache metadata, integrity issues and references. Exact cache keys identify verify/repair/cleanup targets. No raw file inventories. Includes shared busy/cancellable/message/error activity for tasks started in GUI or Agent; use operation_cancel with domain=libraries to request cancellation, then read state until busy clears.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_install
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install exact version label returned by libraries_search; writes project manifest/lock and mounts using shared atomic transactions. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_remove
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove project dependency; preserves global cached sources. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_restore
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Restore dependencies using authoritative lockfile commits; never silently re-resolve tags. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_verify
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Verify one exact cache key or all cached versions. Checks local inventory corruption, not independent supply-chain authenticity. Returns actual failures, trust required.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_repair
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Repair an exact cache key from globalState. Rechecks repository/commit identity; requires trust, supports cancellation and preserves source safety checks.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_cleanupPlan
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read-only preflight of single cache key or mode unused/all. Returns expiring server plan ID, candidates, bytes, protections and impact; does not delete. Requires trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_cleanupExecute
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute an unexpired exact plan ID from cleanupPlan. Independently asks the human to authorize exact targets; JSON cannot approve deletion. Rechecks state/references under store locks. Returns actual removals.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_more_githubStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Refresh silently and read GitHub mode/account label/rate-limit hint only. Never returns tokens or session objects.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_more_authorizeGitHub
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start real interactive VS Code GitHub authentication. User must complete Accounts flow. Returns safe status only; no access token is exposed. Anonymous access remains available.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_development_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read whether extension runs in Development mode. Safe in production; reports reason when cache tools are disabled.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_development_listCaches
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Development mode only. Returns bounded cache IDs/names/scopes without values. Installed runtimes, exporter and library sources/reference indices are excluded. Returns the extension-owned storage directory and pagination metadata; no cache values.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_development_inspectCache
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Development mode only. Inspect one exact cache ID from listCaches. Returns bounded redacted preview, which may still contain personal information. No arbitrary file reads.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_development_clearCaches
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Development mode only. Choose exactly one cache ID, scope or all=true. Independent user confirmation required; clears only disposable caches, reports partial failures and invalidates owners.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_sourceAnalyze
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze Customizer declarations in an explicit workspace .scad URI, including unsaved editor text. Returns source version/hash, actual widgets, ranges, candidates and bounded diagnostics; complete=false is not success. Unlike customizer_state this reads source, not Overrides. Analyze before sourceApply; correct invalid inputs or unsupported forms rather than guessing.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_sourceApply
languageModelTools.displayName: Plan or commit Customizer source edits
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Author Customizer SOURCE, not runtime Overrides: plan bounded literal/annotation/group edits with sourceAnalyze version/hash, inspect preview, then commit the single-use planId within 120 seconds. Successful plans return data.continuation: review the diff and invoke its registered tool with its input unchanged (mode and planId only). requiresReview is guidance, never authorization or a Commit input field. Requires Workspace Trust and commit confirmation; never accepts model approval. Writes only the buffer, never saves. On STALE_SOURCE reanalyze and replan; on NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW stop unchanged-source retries, use ordinary editor changes only if the user task permits them, otherwise explain manual handling. Check applied AND semanticPass/postValidation; never claim success after failure.

mode.description: plan requires uri, identity.version, identity.sha256 and edits; commit requires only planId. Copy identity and planId from actual previous results.

identity.description: Nested object copied from sourceAnalyze data.identity: version is a number and sha256 is a string. Do not send version or sha256 as root fields.

edits.description: Array of intent DATA objects. Each has one exact kind and name, with the fields required by that kind. Do not send JSON Schema keywords or a shell command.

planId.description: Opaque ID from a successful sourceApply mode=plan data.planId. Never use sourceAnalyze operation.id.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_sourceValidate
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read and validate current workspace .scad buffer against optional explicit widget/type/group/default/range/choice expectations. Unlike customizer_state, validates source declarations, not Overrides. Without expectations proves only static consistency. complete=false or semanticPass=false is failure. Runtime and GUI checks are separately notRequested; use existing Preview when requested. Correct diagnostics and validate again. Unmet explicit targets are returned in expectationResults, never as syntax errors or Problems diagnostics. With no expectations, missing Customizer grammar and normal SCAD usage are not diagnostic failures. Inspect sourceStatus, contractStatus, qualityStatus and per-target details; contractStatus=notRequested does not establish a target.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_analyze
languageModelTools.displayName: Analyze CAD diagnostics or verify raw mesh
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze an explicit workspace URI without Preview. Default diagnostics preserves SCAD/CSG CLI diagnostics. mode=verify Full Renders SCAD/CSG to frozen STL or audits standalone STL/3MF without a runtime. Returns snapshot-bound raw format/topology/intersection/shell checks and mesh measurements. Requires Workspace Trust. No source writes, mesh repair, assembly or printability proof. Read units, completeness and UNRESOLVED checks; ok:true means a report was returned, not PASS. After edits analyze again. SCAD and PNG require the selected official CLI.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_getIssue
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read one issue from a specific analysis report. Optional bounded local CLI evidence; includes runtime, snapshot ID and whether the report is still current. Expired reports are not recomputed implicitly. Historical results are evidence only; analyze the current document before claiming a repair. No source writes or CLI execution. Geometry v2 includes bounded triangle/component/spatial evidence and pagination. Binary mesh issues have model-level positions, never invented source lines.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_measure
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read basic mesh measurements by existing reportId, or explicitly verify a workspace uri first. Report IDs never recompile missing/expired evidence. Includes snapshot/current status, units, scope and unresolved items. Physical volume is returned only when raw topology, self-intersection, shell composition and winding permit it. Based on exported mesh; no analytic surface, assembly or printability proof. Standalone STL/3MF requires no runtime. Workspace Trust required. For assembly v3 reportId, partIds selects declared frozen parts; no implicit assembly compilation. Assembly total volume is not computed.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_renderViews
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Render the same frozen mesh artifact using official CLI PNG. Supply uri to verify first, or reportId to use existing evidence only. Default iso/front/top 512x512, at most four views. Metadata/artifact delivery by default. Explicit inline uses native image parts within 4 MiB, otherwise metadata fallback. Camera, source/rendered hashes, runtime and display quantization accompany images. Images are display evidence, not visual PASS. Missing runtime/render environment leaves geometry evidence valid. Requires Workspace Trust; no source writes. For assembly v3 reportId, partIds selects declared frozen parts; no implicit assembly compilation. Assembly total volume is not computed.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_listParts
languageModelTools.displayName: List declared CAD parts and constraints
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read optional .scad/verification.json declarations or an existing v3 report without compiling. Returns stable author IDs scoped to canonical Manifest URI, manifestDigest for repair baseline, and paginated parts/checks. Relative entries resolve from project root (parent of .scad). Missing Manifest returns UNRESOLVED NO_STABLE_PARTS. Requires Workspace Trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_checkAssembly
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Freeze every declared part and validate all required raw-solid prerequisites and Manifest constraints in one snapshot. URI executes; reportId only reads existing evidence. expectedManifestDigest locks the repair baseline; pairIds can add geometric pair queries but cannot replace or override required checks. Distances are conservative intervals on frozen exported meshes. No overlap-volume, repair, motion or printability check. Requires Workspace Trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_compare
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compare existing v2/v3 reports or explicitly retained baselines, without compilation. Stable identity is Manifest URI + declared partId, or whole document URI for v2. Summaries only; exported mesh changes do not prove local-region preservation. Required constraint removal/changes never count as repair. Optional expectUnchangedPartIds protects whole local mesh and assembly pose. Requires Trust. To CREATE a comparison, pass baselineReportId AND targetReportId. reportId ONLY reads a comparison report returned by this tool; never put a v2/v3 model ID there.

reportId.description: Read a prior comparison result only; not a source v2/v3 model ID.

baselineReportId.description: Frozen v2/v3 model report ID used as the before baseline. Required together with targetReportId to create a comparison.

targetReportId.description: Frozen v2/v3 model report ID used as the after target. Required together with baselineReportId.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_getFeedback
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read bounded persistent user feedback and retained baseline identities, revisions and stale state. Provide one owner URI or frozen reportId. Optional targetReportId proposes only provable identical-local-mesh rigid remap candidates; no remap is accepted automatically. Requires Trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_requestPointing
languageModelTools.displayName: Ask user for CAD surface feedback
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a frozen evidence view and wait for a human to select a surface and explicitly submit, or confirm a proven remap candidate. No source modification; no synthetic coordinates accepted. Current snapshot required, model PASS not required. Default timeout120s, max240s. User cancellation/timeout creates no feedback. Requires graphical interaction and Trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_checkPrintability
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Screen one frozen mesh against an explicit local mm FDM profile: build envelope and numerical overhang triangle candidates only. No thickness, bridges, support, slicer or manufacturing guarantee; printability remains NOT_CHECKED. For v3 choose partId; uses local geometry and print pose, ignoring assembly pose. Existing print assessment reportId reads only. No automatic unit assumption or source compilation. Requires Trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_manageReview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Explicitly retain/release a frozen baseline, or resolve/reopen/delete user feedback using its current revision. Changes local review records only, never geometry or constraints. Resolved feedback does not imply model PASS. Retained geometry persists across restart; bounded capacity has no silent eviction. Requires Trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_model_editBuffer
languageModelTools.displayName: Plan or apply a CAD buffer edit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Plan one exact, unique text replacement in an open dirty workspace SCAD buffer using document.version and document.sourceSha256 from diagnostics. Review the preview, then call the returned commit continuation. Commit requires a separate VS Code Apply decision, consumes the plan, and never saves files. Requires Workspace Trust and Auto Save off.

scripts.test: npm run compile-tests && node --test out/test/capabilities.test.js out/test/capabilityServices.test.js out/test/notifications.test.js out/test/runtime.test.js out/test/github.test.js out/test/installation.test.js out/test/customizer.test.js out/test/customizerSource*.test.js out/test/language.test.js out/test/markdown.test.js && npm run test:libraries && npm run test:preview && npm run test:mesh && npm run test:cad:unit && npm run test:assembly && npm run test:review
scripts.test:capabilities: npm run compile-tests && node --test out/test/capabilities.test.js out/test/capabilityServices.test.js
scripts.test:customizer: npm run compile-tests && node esbuild.js && node --test scripts/customizer-scrollbar.test.mjs scripts/customizer-preview-fields.test.mjs
scripts.test:fast-preview: npm run compile && node --import tsx --test src/test/preview/preparedScene.test.ts src/test/preview/fastPreview.test.ts && node --test scripts/preview-fast.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test
scripts.test:libraries:integration: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test --grep "Library Manager extension host"
scripts.test:markdown: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && node --test out/test/markdown.test.js && node --test scripts/markdown-preview.test.mjs
